rationale: The repeated control runs establish the reproducible starting contrast needed to begin delta debugging under the already specified workload and decision rule. This checks ordinary instantiation of the source procedure; it does not add an evidential bridge or change the mechanism, inference, or target. The mapping explicitly withholds reduction if this contrast cannot be established.

if_execution.verification_or_satisfaction_method: Repeat baseline and full-delta runs under the identical fixed replay workload using the preset repeat count, metric, margin, and inconclusive band. Confirm distinguishable baseline-pass and full-delta-fail outcomes against the observed run-to-run variation before starting reduction.
